_readme: Fixed question set for nyc-record-mcp, written 2026-11-18 before scoring. Each expected answer was found first with an independent SoQL query to NYC Open Data dataset dg92-zbpx (not through this server), on 2026-11-18.

Run: npm run eval (offline, replays eval/fixtures/). npm run eval -- --record re-asks NYC Open Data live and rewrites the fixtures; then the answers below may no longer hold, because the dataset grows every day.

Checks on the answer's JSON body: `field` [path, value] (a dotted path equals a value), `top` {index, field: value...} (the notice at that index has these values), `any` {field: value...} (some notice has all of them), `all_prefix` [field, prefix] (every notice's field starts with it), `all_in` [field, [values]] (every notice's field is one of them), `count` [field, value, n] (exactly n notices have field = value), `error` regex (the answer is isError and its text matches).

Invariants on every non-error answer: the source block names City Record Online, the NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services and https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/dg92-zbpx, with as_of_kind retrieved, and the text ends with that Link line; showing equals the number of notices.

questions.q: When is the next City Planning Commission public hearing?
questions.note: Asked on 2026-11-18: the Nov 18 hearing is that day; the next notice published is for Dec 2.

questions.q: Is there a hearing on the City Environmental Quality Review fee rule?
Which open City solicitation closes soonest?
questions.note: As of 2026-11-18 in New York. The fixture key replaces the date with <today>, so the replay holds on any day.

questions.q: How many City Record notices were published on November 17, 2026?
How many contract awards were published on November 17, 2026?
What was the most recent sale notice?
What is the newest procurement notice?
Show notices from the Mayor's Office.
questions.note: An apostrophe in the agency name: 4,114 notices across seven Mayor's Office agencies on 2026-11-18.

questions.q: Show me the next page of public hearings (notices 26 to 50).
List the last vendor-list notices (the third page of 100).
questions.note: 294 Vendor List notices in all on 2026-11-18.

questions.q: Which Parks notices are in Council District 10?
questions.note: The dataset has no Council district; the call must be refused, not answered for all of Parks.
